data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Integrate Real-Time Metrics
features.description: Display real-time metrics using Chart.js graphs for LLM cost, stage completion, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time data is accurately reflected in charts.
Graphs include line, bar, and area charts.
Data updates dynamically during the presentation.

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts.
Charts are interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Highlight Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Present TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays code quality metrics.
TDD and SOLID principles are clearly represented.
Chart is visually appealing and informative.

features.title: Display Recent Run Results
features.description: Show actual data from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Recent run data is included in the presentation.
Data is accurate and relevant to the audience.
Charts effectively communicate the results.

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight Artemis features such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Features are clearly explained in the presentation.
Charts effectively demonstrate each feature.
Information is accurate and up-to-date.

features.title: Demonstrate Supervisor Integration
features.description: Use a pie chart to show supervisor integration across different stages.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data.
Chart is clear and easy to understand.
Integration details are highlighted effectively.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set time interval.
Users can manually navigate through slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth.
Overall design is professional and cohesive.
